Interactive graph or tool in Lesson 4 (Economic Systems). Its current state, as the student sees it:
The circular flow
Textbook 1.3 and your course video. Switch between following the stuff and following the money.
[selected: Both]
[graph: Goods & services market · firms sell, households buy · Factor market · households sell, firms buy · Households · own resources · Firms · make products · Goods &services · Goods &services · Labor, land,capital · Labor, land,capital · Spending · Revenue · Wages, rent,interest, profit · Income]
Both loops together: every flow of stuff is matched by a flow of money going the other way. Households are buyers in one market and sellers in the other; so are firms.
